hook: Beck has spent over 17 years inside Daimler's IT organisation, running IT for Daimler Trucks Asia and Mitsubishi Fuso from Tokyo before becoming CIO of Daimler Truck North America in 2018, where he also now heads IT for autonomous driving. He speaks German, English, French, and Spanish.
name: Lutz Beck

reading.body:
Lutz Beck is a long-tenure Daimler IT executive whose current role combines conventional enterprise IT leadership with responsibility for the IT infrastructure supporting autonomous driving at Daimler Truck North America.

His career follows a single-organisation arc across more than two decades, moving from ERP rollouts in Asia Pacific and sales application reengineering across Europe to regional CIO positions in Tokyo and then Portland. The consistent thread is scale: each role expanded the geographic or functional scope of the previous one, covering eleven countries for a European sales rollout, then all of Daimler Trucks Asia, then North America. The autonomous driving IT remit, added to the North America CIO role from 2018, is the point where his profile intersects with questions of compute and AI infrastructure, because autonomous trucking systems depend on sensor fusion, real-time inference, and the data pipelines that feed model development. The data does not describe what that infrastructure looks like, how large it is, or how it connects to external compute or power resources.

What the data covers is organisational biography drawn from a single primary source, his LinkedIn profile. It establishes tenure, geography, and reporting scope, but contains no technical specifications, no budget figures, and no detail on the architecture or compute strategy behind the autonomous driving IT work. Beck is a relevant figure for understanding who manages AI-adjacent infrastructure inside a major commercial vehicle manufacturer, but the data supports that framing only at the level of job title and stated remit.

timeline.impact: Heads ERP/SAP template implementation across Asia Pacific and Africa for Daimler entities, based in Singapore
Leads program management for a common European sales application reengineering and SAP template rollout across eleven countries
Heads IT management for wholesale sales Europe and commercial vehicle ordering

timeline.event: Executive Director, IT Management, Daimler AG
timeline.impact: Runs IT finance, controlling, procurement and business intelligence; serves on boards of Daimler Group Services in Madrid and the Philippines
Serves over six years as CIO for Daimler Trucks Asia and Mitsubishi Fuso Truck & Bus Corporation, based in Tokyo
Leads IT for Daimler Truck North America and heads IT for autonomous driving, based in Portland, Oregon

quick_facts: CIO of Daimler Truck North America since 2018, also heading IT for autonomous driving
Previously CIO of Daimler Trucks Asia and Mitsubishi Fuso Truck & Bus Corporation for over six years in Tokyo
